inputs.sbc_source: FY2025 AR note 32(a): employee share option scheme charge RMB(0.3)m (FY2024 RMB1.0m) -- immaterial; SBC-zero market, rows kept explicit at 0%
inputs.buyback_note: Repurchases negligible (FY2024 RMB74.8m, FY2025 nil, H1 FY2026 RMB1.0m); flat count is a modelling convention, not funded by buybacks, but there is also no dilution source.
inputs.fx_note: CNY->HKD 1.1721 (HKD per CNY), Yahoo CNYHKD=X regularMarketPrice at 2026-10-09 close. Direction check: USD/HKD ~7.8 / USD/CNY ~6.65 = ~1.17, consistent with the RMB appreciation behind the H1 FY2026 FX loss on USD balances. No A-share dual listing to parity-check against. Per-share values are computed in CNY and converted to HKD; refresh_price.py does not move this rate.
inputs.share_count_basis: 2,507.6m shares at H1 FY2026; FY2025 diluted weighted average 2,507.649m -- outstanding options are out of the money, so basic ~= diluted. Held flat (no SBC, no planned issuance).
inputs.net_debt_basis: H1 FY2026 (30 Jun 2026): borrowings 21,254.7 (21,155.7 non-current + 99.0 current) + lease liabilities 0.8 = 21,255.5; less cash 13,873.1 and restricted bank balances 7,665.9 (pledged against the borrowings, so they belong with them) = 21,538.9. Net cash RMB283.5m. Gross leverage is a deliberate carry trade (84% fixed-rate RMB debt vs USD/RMB deposits); netting it is right because the flows are unlevered and the carry is excluded from them.
inputs.wacc_rationale: Built in CNY: China 10y CGB ~1.8% + beta 1.1 x CNY ERP 6.5% = ~9.0% cost of equity; net debt ~nil so WACC ~= CoE. +1.0pp for structural, non-cyclical risks that the scenario flows do not carry: single-country (PRC) asset and policy concentration incl. corn/coal policy, UFLPA/Xinjiang export-compliance exposure (Xinjiang production base), HK-listed Cayman structure. Commodity cyclicality and EU anti-dumping/anti-absorption outcomes are charged in the scenario flows and weights, not in the rate -- risk charged once. Same 10.0% in all three scenarios.
inputs.lease_treatment: Treatment (A), leases as debt: lease liabilities RMB0.8m included in total_debt; principal (RMB1.1m FY2025) not deducted from flows. Immaterial either way.
inputs.nci_treatment: No non-controlling interests: all FY2025 profit (RMB2,465.2m) is attributable to shareholders. No adjustment.
inputs.interest_treatment: Fufeng classifies interest received (RMB537.8m FY2025) in INVESTING, so it is not inside reported FCF (OCF - capex) and interest_income deducted from reported FCF is 0. Interest paid (RMB279.5m) sits inside OCF, so reported FCF is post-interest; the component build is unlevered (EBITDA-based) and the net cash/debt is bridged once.
inputs.normalisation_note: Underlying operating EBITDA (operating profit ex lawsuit indemnity, FX gains/losses and PPE disposal gains, plus PPE/ROU depreciation and intangible amortisation) as % of revenue: FY2018 ~23.7, FY2019 ~15.3, FY2020 ~11.2 (trough), FY2021 ~12.2, FY2022 ~21.7 (peak), FY2023 ~16.7, FY2024 ~12.8, FY2025 ~14.1 (ex RMB233m Meihua indemnity and RMB208m FX loss), H1 FY2026 ~11.0 (operating profit 318 + 518 FX loss + ~676 D&A on revenue 13,795). Eight-year average ~16% including two peak years; mid-cycle taken as 15% in base. Year 1 (FY2026) at 11.5% reflects H1 trough plus guided weak H2 prices; neither the H1 FY2026 FX-depressed print nor the FY2025 litigation-inflated figure is extrapolated.
inputs.capex_note: FY2025 capex 2,670.6 (9.6% of revenue) and H1 FY2026 1,610.2 are elevated by Kazakhstan Phase I (project up to US$1.5bn over multiple phases). Maintenance ~D&A (~4.7% of revenue). Base path 11% in FY2026, tapering to 5.5% by year 5 -- slightly above D&A to fund ~3% volume growth; Phase II spend is in the bull path.
inputs.notes: Model: owner-FCF DCF, component build, per .claude/skills/dcf-methods routing row 'operating company, non-US or cyclical' plus owner-fcf-adaptations (currency-matched CNY WACC, CNY flows vs HKD quote, SBC-zero market, risk charged once). Fufeng is a corn-based biofermentation manufacturer (MSG, threonine, lysine, xanthan gum, starch sweeteners) -- a straightforward operating company; no bank/REIT/holdco features. First valuation of this ticker (no MEMORY entry). Cyclical normalisation: margins mean-revert from an FY2026 trough (11.5%) toward a 15% mid-cycle EBITDA margin in base; terminal cap held at 12x for a cyclical commodity producer. SBC immaterial so house and street bases coincide (band_position null). Price is the 2026-10-09 regular close, after the June profit warning and August interim results -- not an after-hours print.

historical_growth.growth_rate_source: judgment: mid-cycle volume growth (~3%) plus Kazakhstan ramp; equity CAGR rejected as base growth because it compounds peak-cycle FY2022-23 retained earnings
historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Equity 3yr CAGR 7.9% vs revenue 3yr CAGR 0.5% and EPS 3yr CAGR -13.6% -- divergence well beyond 30%. Book value grew on retained peak-cycle earnings while revenue stalled and prices fell; 5yr figures start from the FY2020 trough and flatter everything (EPS 5yr 31.6%).
historical_growth.notes: Owner FCF equals reported FCF (no SBC, interest received in investing). FCF 3yr CAGR FY2022 2,572 -> FY2025 241 is -54.6%, driven by Kazakhstan capex and margin compression; 5yr CAGR undefined because FY2020 FCF was negative (-799). FCF series is too capex-cycle-driven to anchor growth.

base.narrative: Prices bottom in FY2026 and margins recover to a 15% mid-cycle EBITDA margin by FY2030; Kazakhstan Phase I adds export volume from FY2027; capex normalises after the overseas build.

bull.narrative: Price recovery that began in late Q1 2026 resumes; Kazakhstan Phase I and II ship tariff-free into Europe/US; margins return toward the historical average including peaks.

bear.narrative: Threonine/lysine/xanthan oversupply persists, EU anti-absorption duties bite and UFLPA restricts Xinjiang-origin exports; margins stay near trough (12%) with only low growth.

scenario_narratives.base: The FY2024-H1 FY2026 down-cycle in MSG, threonine, lysine and xanthan gum prices bottoms in FY2026 (H1 gross profit -25.5% on corn +7% and ASPs -13% to -22%); FY2026 underlying EBITDA margin ~11.5% with the RMB518m H1 FX loss treated as non-operating. From FY2027 the Fufeng/Meihua MSG-threonine oligopoly regains some pricing discipline as marginal producers stop adding capacity, and Kazakhstan Phase I adds amino-acid volume for Europe/US. Margin returns to a 15% mid-cycle level (eight-year average ~16% with FY2018 and FY2022 peaks) by FY2030; capex steps down from the Kazakhstan-elevated 11% to 5.5% of revenue. Revenue compounds ~3-5% then fades to 2.5%.
scenario_narratives.bull: Management's 'prices rising from late Q1 2026' call proves right after an H2 wobble; scale and captive coal power let Fufeng out-earn smaller threonine/lysine producers who exit; Kazakhstan Phases I and II reach full rate, sidestepping EU anti-dumping duties on China-origin product and lifting export share. EBITDA margin rebuilds to 17.5% -- below the FY2018/FY2022 peaks of ~22-24% but above mid-cycle -- with revenue growth of 6-7% in FY2027-28 and heavier capex to fund Phase II.
scenario_narratives.bear: Threonine, lysine and xanthan gum stay structurally oversupplied (competitor capacity adds, xanthan utilisation only 84%), domestic MSG demand stays weak, the EU anti-absorption investigation raises effective duties on Chinese threonine/lysine, and UFLPA/Xinjiang compliance limits US-bound exports from the Xinjiang base. Revenue falls 4% in FY2026 and grows only ~2% thereafter; EBITDA margin is stuck at 12%, close to the FY2020-21 trough levels. Kazakhstan ramps slowly with a long running-in period.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Bear raised from the 15% house default to 25%: management walked back its FY2025 'cycle has bottomed' tone at the H1 FY2026 interim, and live EU anti-absorption and UFLPA risks are outside the company's control. Base 50%: the mid-cycle margin path is anchored to an eight-year history, not a peak. Bull cut from 35% to 25%: it needs a price recovery AND successful Kazakhstan Phase I/II execution, two independent things going right.

valuation_philosophy.summary: Cycle-normalised owner-FCF DCF for a commodity biofermentation producer. The valuation deliberately does not capitalise either the H1 FY2026 trough (operating profit RMB318m, depressed by a RMB518m unhedged FX loss and margin compression) or the FY2025 figure flattered by the RMB233m Meihua settlement. Margins mean-revert to a mid-cycle 15% EBITDA margin, terminal value capped at 12x FCF, and the gross-levered carry trade is netted to ~zero net debt.
key_risks_to_valuation: Mid-cycle margin assumption: each 1pp of terminal EBITDA margin is worth roughly 8% of base value; a structurally oversupplied threonine/lysine/xanthan industry could make 12% the new mid-cycle (the bear case)
Unhedged USD cash and receivables: reported earnings will keep swinging with USD/CNY; excluded from the flows as non-operating but real to cash value of the USD balances
Carry-trade balance sheet: RMB21.3bn borrowings against RMB21.5bn cash/restricted deposits; net debt is ~nil only while the deposits remain available and the spread holds
EU anti-dumping/anti-absorption duties on threonine/lysine and UFLPA/Xinjiang export-compliance exposure
Kazakhstan execution: first overseas plant, up to US$1.5bn total project; overruns or a slow ramp extend the high-capex period
PRC single-country concentration and corn/coal policy dependence
